Names: GLENWOOD AVE.; GHOLSON printed without a suffix (recorded as Gholson Avenue); WASHINGTON / AVE.; VAN ANTWERP / ROAD; ROSEDALE PL.; FOREST ... AVENUE; ROCKDALE ... (west part narrow, ~30 ft, with only ST. printed between Harvey and Knott; east part MAPLE at y~4550 begins at Knott); CATHERINE / ST. and KASOTA / ST. (names printed west of the strip near Burnet); HALE AVE.; BLAIR AVE.; RIDGEWAY (west of the strip) / AVE.; Highland Place printed PL. near Maple and HIGHLAND near Hale (one continuous street, house numbers 3463/3464 to 3412/3419). Carplin/Morris: horizontal street printed CARPLIN west of x 7450, vertical leg south to Ridgeway printed CARPLIN PL., horizontal east of x 7450 printed MORRIS (diagonal letters) ... PL.; recorded as Carplin Place and Morris Place, but MORRIS could be a subdivision name, in which case the east part is also Carplin Place. Stewart Place: STEWART printed on the west stretch (no suffix), the street curves NE and runs east to Reading as the stretch printed PL.; recorded as one street Stewart Place (assumption). The thin band between Stewart's triangle block and Buchwalter's Sub. is a lot line pair, not a street. Reading Road (REA... printed at the plate edge) is cut by the SE plate edge; its centre is taken midway between its west line and the plate edge (Reading appears ~65-75 ft wide there). Alaska Avenue/Glenwood junction lies at the plate's top edge. Delaware Avenue (x~6240) and Franklin Ct. (x~6210) lie just outside the overlap and are not picked.
